about.title: About Savina
about.tagline: The story and mission of an EdTech company for the AI era

story.title: Our Story
story.content: Savina International Investment Co., Ltd. is an EdTech company focused on education and AI technology. We believe traditional education alone is no longer enough for today's world — degrees still matter, but they're not sufficient. Savina was founded to close that gap: combining accredited distance university enrollment with an AI-integrated e-learning platform, practical AI skills training, and high-quality talent placement for partner enterprises.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: Bring high-quality learning and career opportunities to Vietnamese people — especially the community living and working in Japan, Korea, and Taiwan — through convenient, practical EdTech solutions aligned with real social needs.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.content: Become Vietnam's leading EdTech enterprise combining accredited distance university degrees with applied AI skills — building a generation of talent ready for the AI era.
